# Sandcat
# Regenerated by `sandcat init`. Everything else under .devcontainer/
# is regenerated on next init or contains per-machine state; only
# devbox.tools.json is your project-shared tool list and stays in git.
# Sandcat manages this whole block; re-running init with
# `--features no-gitignore` (or SANDCAT_GITIGNORE=false) removes it.
.devcontainer/*
!.devcontainer/devbox.tools.json
.sandcat/settings.local.json
# /Sandcat
